items.title: 5年后，Netflix还会涉足游戏领域吗？这是首席执行官所说的
items.summary: Netflix has been experimenting with video games for a while, but is the streaming giant going to eventually dr

content.v: Netflix has been experimenting with video games for a while, but is the streaming giant going to eventually drop out of gaming? That's the question Bloomberg's Lucas Shaw put to Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos at the Screentime event this week .

Regarding whether Netflix will still host games in five years, Sarandos said, "I think so." He said Netflix's push into mobile gaming was "a gateway to cloud gaming," which is something Netflix is "much more interested in."

Netflix hosts a variety of mobile games, including Red Dead Redemption, Sonic Mania Plus, and RollerCoaster Tycoon Touch, just to name a few. The games are included with a Netflix membership and have no ads. Netflix also hosts streaming games that can be played on your TV, and they are more family- and party-focused.

Netflix's gaming ambitions have bounced around over the years. At one point, the company wanted to make big, AAA games, and hired some big names to get it done. However, Netflix later wound down these efforts , closing studios and laying off staff in the process, leading many to wonder what Netflix's ambition for video games actually was.

Sarandos said cloud gaming makes more sense for Netflix "in a post-console world." He didn't elaborate here, but it sounds like he's talking about a future where more and more people play games without dedicated hardware like a PlayStation, Xbox, or Switch console. All of those systems have gone up in price in recent times due to AI-fueled component and memory issues, along with bigger global macroeconomic trends.

The cloud gaming market hasn't popped the way some have predicted, but Sarandos isn't the only person who is optimistic about the future potential. Strauss Zelnick, the head of GTA 6 owner Take-Two recently said , "I think we'll be in commercial streaming mode within three years."
Sarandos said there will be "all kinds of opportunities for gaming on the television," and the executive said Netflix wanted to be "early invested in that."
"I like it for IP extension. I certainly like it for brand value, for people who want to spend time on that screen gaming instead of watching, then we have an option for them," he said.

Also in the interview, Sarandos was asked if Netflix would again reach into its coffers to buy a large-scale gaming company to help its gaming ambitions become realized faster. The interviewer asked if Netflix could buy Take-Two or Xbox, and Sarandos said it doesn't have any specific plans to buy more gaming studios, though he's not ruling anything out either. For what it's worth, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma recently said Xbox is not for sale , while Take-Two selling itself would be shocking.

Sarandos said Netflix prefers to grow organically instead of buying companies to spur growth. Of course, this isn't a hard-and-fast rule, as evidenced by Netflix offering to buy Warner Bros. Discover for many billions of dollars before Paramount swooped in and made a deal. He said Netflix went after WBD because the company was "so clean" and contained only the elements and assets of the business that Netflix actually wanted, and that was rare.
Netflix will look at other opportunities to buy game studios if they complement the company's wider business goals, Sarandos said.
In other news about cloud gaming, Microsoft has reportedly canceled its new controller for it , ahead of price hikes to the service soon .

Netflix has also said it's still very early days for its gaming output, saying the company has “tons more work to do." Netflix's financial investment in gaming is minuscule relative to its other business areas, and management sees gaming as a "significant market opportunity." Netflix investors no doubt want to see Netflix find new ways to make money; after all, Netflix stock has crashed more than 25% in 2026 so far.

items.title: 全新《GTA 6》截图聚焦露西亚和杰森的关系
items.summary: Rockstar has further ramped up its GTA 6 marketing today with the launch of several new screenshots focusing o

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/jason-lucia-1790783485719.png
Rockstar has further ramped up its GTA 6 marketing today with the launch of several new screenshots focusing on protagonists Lucia and Jason.

GTA 6's dynamic criminal duo can be seen in four new images published via Love Magazine , which features an illustration of the couple on its cover, and a black-and-white screenshot of the pair in more casual clothes (Jason in a white vest, jacked arms on show, Lucia in a leopard-print crop top).

Two more images show Lucia and Jason together in the booth of a diner, but sat opposite. Is this the setting of a heist planning session, or are the two about to hold-up the very diner they're sat in? Are they having a date, or an argument about the way their criminal undertakings are going? What looks like a large bag set to be filled with stolen money suggests something is afoot.
Next up are images of Lucia and Jason in more stylish clothes (well, Jason is in bike leathers), and looking fierce while playing pool in what appears to be a biker bar.

The article also includes further detail from Rockstar senior vice president of narrative, Rupert Humphries, who discussed the pair's pursuit of the American Dream. GTA 6 portrays this as the couple seeking the ability to own a house and pay off their various debts, rather than a desire to become billionaires. “If you are going to put all this effort into creating a version of today’s world, it has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face,” Humphries said. “Otherwise, you could just go outside and live in the real world.”

"We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other,” game writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern told Love. “That’s what we felt made them authentic, and a great team.” Game writer Alexa D’Agostino added: “When you are focusing on writing a fully realised person with their own wants, you’re going to get something perfectly imperfect — with clichés, but also undeniably real.”

Speaking of GTA 6 marketing ramping up, The Miami Heat announced it would be heading to Vice City for its next NBA match against the Milwaukee Bucks . The one-night-only event, hosted live on ESPN, has been dubbed A Night in Vice City, and will see the home team donning an "all-new uniform on a never-before-seen court."
We've got extensive coverage of GTA 6 across IGN. Check out IGN's interview with Rockstar Games , our GTA 6 preview , and word of the first confirmed GTA 6 voice actor .

items.title: B站百大锐评金刚狼：男挫女土 12语无中配 战斗垃圾
items.summary: 近日，B站美漫区影视区百大UP主@BuriedAlien 发布了一期视频，简要点评了《漫威金刚狼》，并表示他对于这款游戏“非常失望”。

content.v: 近日，B站美漫区影视区百大UP主@BuriedAlien 发布了一期视频，简要点评了《漫威金刚狼》，并表示他对于这款游戏“非常失望”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301550056440.png
BuriedAlien先是批评了游戏的建模，认为不论是主角金刚狼还是琴·格蕾、魔形女等配角，其游戏形象都“太路人了”，直言“超英游戏没有帅气男主和骚气女主我玩啥”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301552497133.jpg
与此同时他还指出，游戏中金刚狼的身材比例也很糟糕，虽然他也承认在漫画当中，罗根的身高就是只有160厘米，但大家早已接受休·杰克曼版的魁梧金刚狼，而且其整体比例也不够美观，“头大没脖子，很多角度里手比腿还长。（……）而且不不只是金刚狼，其他女性比例也是这样。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301553015451.jpg
至于游戏性的部分，BuriedAlien也没有给出了相当负面的评价，他指出，游戏不仅“不好玩”，还“作为一款不到20小时就能全成就的体量”，首发售价大约460多元，游戏唯一符合一线3A独占大作的“只有这个价格”。
而且这个价格还没有中文配音，BuriedAlien表示，现在很多二三线小工作室都纷纷给自己的游戏加上中文语音来讨好中国市场，可《漫威金刚狼》却没有。游戏共12国语言，抛开英法等主流语种，游戏甚至支持俄语、阿拉伯语和波兰语，但却没有中文配音，他不无讽刺地说道：“谢谢你索尼，我真的有被尊重到。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301553349899.png
至于游戏最核心的战斗部分，BuriedAlien评价称“很垃圾”，他表示，初上手时确实感觉到了硬核暴力的近身断肢缠斗，视觉效果极具冲击力，但“这种初期的爽感只是假象，因为越往后玩，战斗死板单调重复的问题就越暴露出来。”
他指出，“首先技能体系设计严重脱节，游戏中有6个专属技能，但那些都与普通的攻击，无法形成流畅的连招衔接，完全独立于普攻之外，无法实现招式变奏和自由组合。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301553429879.jpg
并且，“敌人模板非常有限，基本上就是是掠夺者、忍者、机甲哨兵三类，每次都是近战拿小刀+一个拿盾的+一个远程狙击。哪怕是精英怪也是单纯堆血量霸体，但智商都是一样蠢，而且这三类还有一大堆换皮。”
“而我们整局下来的对战战斗逻辑，就是‘普攻刮痧+技能冷却刷新’的死板循环，全程套路固定，没有操作博弈，也没有流派搭配。不给玩家思考战术，你只需平砍，等待技能亮灯释放即可，十几个小时全程重复同一套战斗模板。再加上关卡设计也是极度重复的情况下，玩这个游戏堪比坐牢。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301553508372.jpg
关于游戏的Boss战，本作一共只有5个Boss，不仅数量少，“设计得也很敷衍，没有任何记忆点”。“全程也是冲上去挠几下，然后躲技能再挠，毫无设计可言，就算boss有第二或者第三阶段，也就是多一两个技能，你该怎么打还是怎么打。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301553597176.jpg
BuriedAlien还以游戏中那些自动执行的QTE和无需手动操作便能几乎一路冲到底的摩托车追逐战举例，认为“整个游戏充满了未完工的迹象”。
至于剧情，BuriedAlien评价其“全程平铺直叙且注水拖沓，大量冗余对话强行填充时长。如果你想看到《漫威蜘蛛侠》那种‘脱下你的面具，让我看看我的侄子的脸’的泪目场景，你别指望了没有的。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301554069632.jpg
不过，他也肯定了失眠组曾作出的努力：“当然游戏其实还是有努力地通过演出去凑这对男女主。”游戏中也有一些《双人成行》既视感的桥段，不过可惜并没有《双人成行》那种精妙的设计。
视频末尾，他总结表示：“《漫威金刚狼》让我直接打破了曾经对失眠组的信任，他们以前的作品几乎0差评，稳定的高质量输出，让玩家无条件信任他们。不敢说神作，但下限是极高的。我不爽《漫威金刚狼》不仅是游戏质量差，更是失眠组这样的王牌工作室也开始摆烂割韭菜了吗？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609301554188110.png
“我玩这款游戏最大的感受，就是他们缺乏对这款游戏的爱，感觉就像是他们跟甲方签了一个长期合约，里面包含了金刚狼，不做也得做。因为这个游戏就是给我一种‘他们明明想做很多但一个都没有做到的感觉’。”
“当然了如果硬要说优点也不是没有，起码我是挺喜欢那个反派的，他初期有X教授的感觉，后期有万磁王的反叛，这个反派选的是没有错了。再退一步，如果你对游戏本身要求也不高，只是想下班的时候打开游戏机爽一下，那这个割草游戏其实也挺适合你的。”

items.title: 《控制:共振》玩家评测：绿美迪的翻身大作

content.v: 你如果没玩过前作的话并没关系，但是你可能会感觉太多故事内容一下子砸到你了。
美国研究超自然的部门叫FBC（the Federal Bureau of Control，联邦控制局），他们弄来一个小孩儿做研究，小孩儿叫Dylan Faden，然而为了推进科学，他们对待这个6号实验品越来越不仁道，而且急功近利了。
结果几年后，这个6号实验品挣脱控制，被Hiss控制了，开始尝试突破这个FBC的控制。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/09/27/origin_13660617_4842208.jpg
6号在第一天就杀了500多人。
为了调查父母死亡真相和寻找自己的弟弟的Jesse Faden也正好在弟弟逃出挣脱后成为了FBC的负责人。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/09/27/origin_13660617_4842203.jpg
最后在一代的故事里，姐姐把Hiss打败了，让弟弟挣脱了控制，弟弟从此进入昏迷。
第一代Control是2019年发售的，Remedy可能是为了演员年龄符合故事需求，总是把现实和游戏里的时间同步。
所以在故事里，弟弟昏迷了7年，这一醒来，大事不妙，FBC总部，也就是所谓的“最老的房子”（The Oldest House）门口破了一个大洞。
整个纽约完犊子了···而且姐姐也不见了。
主角也成了一代大反派，Dylan Faden
这一段开局我拿最高画质录制了32：9的开场，没有解说，有兴趣的可以看一下：
控制：共振 最高画质32：9无解说
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/09/27/origin_13660617_4842204.jpg
你如果不知道为什么所有人要不就怕你，要不就恨你恨的咬牙切齿，那···建议你玩一下一代你就知道了。
熟悉Remedy的玩家要知道这个组有三个特点：
1. 故事一直都是业界顶级
2. 总是能用自研引擎隐藏自己其实制作成本不高（相对）而假装成一个AAA作品
3. 这么多年下来，公司财务依然还是比较脆弱（相对），也就是没挣到什么钱
先说 故事 吧，故事这次很多人说这个游戏故事估计不行，因为不是Sam Lake参与的故事。
还有人说这个游戏Sam Lake没碰，这个其实也不对，Sam Lake本名叫Sami Järvi，他依然是Creative Director，换了名字很多人没认出来。
但是这个游戏的Game Director是Mikael Kasurinen，剧本是Ashley Smith。
Mikael Kasurinen其实也是Remedy大神之一。
他也是初代Control的Game Director，此外还参与了Max Payne 2，Alan Wake和Quantum Break等作品。而且我玩了这么久，这一次故事也相当精彩。
在故事线上···
我先给大家跪下了···
我发现我24年3月写的Alan Wake的故事整理，第二代的故事忘记补完了，拖稿一拖就是2年多···我错了
我先认错，之后我会简单串烧一下整个两个IP的故事线，就现在来说，简单的讲：
Alan Wake 1 =》 American Nightmare / Alan 被困 =》 Control 的 Ordinary/Faden/FBC =》 Control 主线 =》AWE DLC =》 Alan Wake 2 =》 Night Springs =》 Lake House =》 CONTROL Resonant
整个Remedy Universe的故事可以说是目前游戏作品里最好的一个设定之一。
你需要非常能理解现实扭曲，多元宇宙，时间压缩等概念，才能很好的去理解这个系列。
这一代你不需要玩过前作就可以玩，只不过你真的对游戏故事不熟悉的话，游戏里发生的事情会把你脑子搞爆炸。
引擎 方面
他们还是用从《Quantum Break》开始就使用的自研Northlight Engine。
这一次我认为这个游戏的画面表现可能冲到了这个引擎的极限了，我敢保证这个游戏有许多场景会让你非常 非常的震撼 。
游戏除非长距离走传送门，不然一般都不会有太多读盘。
不是不读盘，是都隐藏的很好。
每次主角抱着头，一个头疼的表情，然后忽然画面上全是鲜血的闪回，这其实就是在隐藏读盘。
接下来会有场景变换了。
当年玩《Dishonored 2》，有那么一关可以用一个东西切换不同时间，进行实时的地图结构切换。
当时把我震撼了。
但是在本作（打字麻烦···以下简称CR）里，地图的场景切换简直被用到了最夸张的地步。
你一会儿走在纽约街上， 忽然一下进入了一个无底洞，周围整个世界都旋转了起来···画面的酷炫程度非常夸张。
但这也很好的掩盖了其实游戏就是一个箱庭式小地图自由探索，进行地图间的电梯啊，爬行啊，许多都是掩盖读盘的桥段，让你觉得是无缝衔接。
说到钱 ，Remedy是有财报公布的，所以他们的惨大家都能看到。
直到现在，他们的项目还是自己没钱做，都是要跪求发行商出钱才能出作品。
2019年的Control开发成本3000万欧元，算是他们当时最大体量的制作了，其中一半的钱是505拿的。
回本后Remedy拿45%的利润，2年后游戏在2021年卖了300万份，营收超过7000万欧，但Remedy拿到手的钱很少。
毕竟Steam扣掉3成，剩下一半儿多505要拿走，回本是回本了，但是没赚什么钱。
Alan Wake 2则是Epic承担开发成本和营销成本，大家当年不都抱怨这个游戏为什么 Epic独占 吗？
结果这么厉害的一个超高分作品就硬是没人买，Epic的平台实在是不行，好游戏也救不过来。
总之后来AW2直到14个月才官宣收回来所有开发成本，后面的销售利润50%会到Remedy。
反正在玩家心中，我相信Remedy名声其实不错，目前来看，不管作品卖的好不好，他们作品大部分都是精品。
但实际上，这个组其实并不是那种财大气粗自己能掏出钱做一个大体量AAA的团队。
虽然是300多快400人的团队，但是感觉一直在挣扎。
这一次的《控制：共振》开发成本50M，已经是他们历史上最大的项目了，但也是一个豪赌。赌注巨大
2024年的时候，Remedy从505手里把Control、Control 2、FBC: Firebreak 以及未来 Control 产品的发行、营销、分销等权利全部买回来，花了1700万欧元。
然后开始和美国影视游戏的独立游戏公司Annapurna（安纳布尔纳影业）合作。

content.v: "the supply-demand environment is only getting tighter".
If you were perhaps hoping that the ongoing memory crisis would abate in the coming months, we have some unfortunate news for you.

As reported by The Register , memory shortages are set to get even worse in 2027, with Sanjay Mehrotra, CEO of Micron Technology, stating that demand is already far exceeding supply. He even goes so far as to say that customers will likely pay "much higher prices" than they did this year.

items.title: 据报道 Pokémon TCG 将于 2027 年推出首个情人节系列
items.summary: Pokémon TCG is reportedly launching its first-ever Valentine's Day box set on January 27, 2027, featuring mini

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/pokemon-valentine-set-tcg-rumor-1790952987076.png
The Pokémon Company is intending to launch the franchise's very first dedicated Valentine's Day collection on January 27, 2027, according to a recent report from Pokébeach .

While the Valentine set is yet to be officially confirmed, the leaks reportedly suggest that the "Pokémon TCG Valentine’s Box" will be similar in practice to the popular Trick or Trade Halloween series, rather than a full expansion release like Pokémon TCG's Delta Reign or Chaos Rising expansions.

These seasonal sets typically come in compact foil packs containing three cards, alongside sticker sheets. The Halloween releases were given their own pumpkin-stamped Pikachu, so I'd put good money on the Valentine's version getting some kind of suitably pink Pika stamp.

The Trick or Trade range was originally designed as a way for kids to hand out Pokémon cards while trick-or-treating, effectively giving them a Pokémon-themed alternative to candy. Given how expensive some Halloween sweets have become, perhaps the cards aren't such a bad substitute.

The reported Valentine's Box appears to be taking a similar approach, with the packaging and packs seemingly designed around giving cards to friends or handing them out in the classroom. The box is also apparently designed to fold into a little cardboard mailbox, allowing cards to be handed out to classmates in the same way kids might exchange Valentine's cards at school.
That's a cute idea, although given the current state of the Pokémon TCG market, I'm not entirely convinced every box will make it into the hands of an actual child.

Previous seasonal releases have generally focused on reprinted cards rather than introducing a bunch of new full-art cards, but that hasn't stopped sealed products from holding surprisingly strong secondary-market value. The Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle (last seen in 2025), for example, contains 40 mini packs with three cards apiece, and currently has a market value of around $75.99 at TCGplayer.

That makes the potential Valentine's release one to keep an eye on, particularly if it proves to be another limited seasonal product. Previous holiday releases have sold out well ahead of launch, so the real competition could come when preorders eventually open.

There's also currently no word on which Pokémon will take centre stage in the mini set. My vote would be Enamorus, although Fairy-type Pokémon aren't currently part of the TCG's standard format... Yet.

I’d also love to see Sylveon - its pink color scheme and cute ribbons would be perfect. Plus, it evolves by friendship! Other options could be Audino and Blissey, since both are linked with care and kindness - qualities that suit Valentine's Day well- or even Pikachu in loveheart-themed clothing might also show up.

Sylveon would also be an obvious choice. Its pink colour scheme and ribbons are practically made for Valentine's Day, while the fact that it evolves through friendship feels particularly appropriate. Audino and Blissey could also fit the theme nicely given their associations with care and kindness, while a loveheart-themed Pikachu would hardly come as a surprise.

items.title: 暴雪在《魔兽世界：永远》中添加了深受喜爱的“凯尔失踪”任务
items.summary: For as much as World of Warcraft Forever has been making an effort to preserve the vanilla WoW experience, the

content.v: For as much as World of Warcraft Forever has been making an effort to preserve the vanilla WoW experience, there are just some things in the game's history that must be added, and the quest 'Kyle's Gone Missing!' is one of them. And Blizzard just added it to Forever.

'Kyle's Gone Missing!' was added during the Burning Crusade expansion through a Make-a-Wish campaign in 2007 for Ezra Chatterton , who was diagnosed with brain cancer earlier that year. Chatterton, who went by the in-game name of Ephoenix, voiced the quest-giver, Ahab Wheathoof, and had his dog Kyle added to the game, which players were then tasked with finding. The quest went live in patch 2.1.2 on June 19, 2007, and has been in the game ever since.

Sadly, a little over a year later, in October 2008, Chatterton passed away at the age of 12 . The quest has remained a beloved part of the game ever since, and Chatterton has also been referenced multiple times, with Blizzard re-naming the Elder of Thunderbluff (who shows up during the annual Lunar Festival) after him in Wrath of the Lich King.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/image-1-1790951982452.webp

But because the quest was added during The Burning Crusade, it's not part of the original game, which meant it wouldn't be in World of Warcraft Forever – even if the zone where the quest takes place is the Tauren starting zone. But, after players asked Blizzard to bring the quest to Forever, it's officially been added.

Blizzard added the patch after players asked for it in the forums, when user Nyaria posted saying, "My Husband was very sad that the Make a Wish Quest involving Kyle wasn’t in Mulgore." They even acknowledged that it doesn't fit the 'Vanilla-only' ethos, but stood by it, saying, "Yes it wasn’t added until TBC, but this is WoW: Forever, we already have new quests added in, and it was a cute little quest, and a Make a Wish addition for a poor kid."

Luckily, shortly after that thread was posted Blizzard community manager Kaivax simply posted: "We're working on it. Stay tuned." The entire rest of the thread is full of players thanking Kaivax and the rest of the Forever team for adding the quest. One player, Ikory, claimed to have been a Make-a-Wish kid who survived and thanked Blizzard in a long post , which they signed off with: "I spent 30 years in crippling pain, with a failing heart, that had to be repaired every few years. I am a survivor. I was that kid who was supposed to die. Now I have a freaken PhD. I lived. Make-A-Wish helped me have hope as a kid. I got my wish. I’m glad Ezra got his wish. Thank you Blizzard for still caring about us Make-A-Wish kids after all these years."
Now, just four days later, the quest is officially live in the World of Warcraft beta, as a part of the October 1 patch .

Johnny Cash, the Blizzard Principal Designer who added the quest, posted on X/Twitter , saying "I had the honor and privilege of bringing "Kyle's Gone Missing!" into WoW: Forever. Ezra Chatterton was an enormous WoW fan, the creator and voice actor behind Ahab Wheathoof, and the creator of Kyle. A tear was shed during this one, my friends. Rest in peace, Ezra."

The quest isn't hard to get to, especially if you start off as a Tauren. Ezra's NPC is in Bloodhoof Village, which is the first town you get to while questing in Mulgore. You can pick up the quest as soon as you hit level 5, and you'll need to hunt down plainstriders (giant ostrich-looking things) until you get Tender Strider Meat, which you will then feed Kyle to get him to return home.

It's nice to see that while Blizzard has been pretty adamant about keeping the spirit of Classic World of Warcraft alive in Forever, it's willing to add a little wiggle room to add beloved pieces of WoW history like this quest. For as much as World of Warcraft has a reputation for gold selling and general toxicity , it's moments like this that remind me just how magical this game is, and how much it means to so many people.

items.title: Fami 通《索尼克》系列诞生 35 周年纪念访谈
items.summary: 以广为人知的刺猬“索尼克”为主角《索尼克》系列即将在 2026 年迎来诞生的 35 周年。 除了游戏，该系列也在电影、动画、周边等多个领域广泛布局，最近甚至还短暂加入了职业电竞战队“ZETA DIVISION”的创作者部

content.v: 以广为人知的刺猬“索尼克”为主角《索尼克》系列即将在 2026 年迎来诞生的 35 周年。
除了游戏，该系列也在电影、动画、周边等多个领域广泛布局，最近甚至还短暂加入了职业电竞战队“ZETA DIVISION”的创作者部门。这个极具速度感与意外性的 IP，始终在为粉丝们带来欢乐。
前不久，《Fami 通》编辑对长期参与《索尼克》系列的制作人饭冢隆先生进行了专访，向他询问了系列发展历程、制定各项企划的初衷以及未来的发展方向。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/881337a59f4fac917d202e57e61d65b8/
饭冢隆 (下文简称为饭冢） 《索尼克》系列综合制作人。1992年加入世嘉，此后参与了多款《索尼克》游戏的制作。
跨越“是否新作已经没有必要了？”的质疑低谷
—— 索尼克系列迎来了诞生的 35 周年，您现在的心情如何？
饭冢： 最直观的感受就是“居然已经过去 35 年了啊”。这期间虽然有过辉煌的时刻，但在经历低谷时，甚至有人对我说过“《索尼克》已经不需要再出新作了吧”。
跨越重重波折，一直苦苦支撑的《索尼克》现在终于有一种要迎来腾飞的感觉了，这真的是一个很棒的 35 周年。
—— 在此过程中，您印象最深的事是什么呢？
饭冢： 毕竟过去了 35 年，发生的事情实在太多了。如果硬要说的话，最能带来感动和成就感的那就是电影化吧。和好莱坞演员一起走在红毯上时，我发自内心地产生了一种“终于走到这一步了”的情绪。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/c2e5fc7d9b592d274f3b4465ed4aef32/
能够在好莱坞电影产业中取得成功的游戏 IP 屈指可数，而《索尼克》系列目前已经制作到了第三部，2027 年还将上映第四部。此外还制作了衍生剧集《纳克鲁斯》。能够实现如此多维度的拓展，我认为是相当值得骄傲的。
—— 您觉得积极进行包括电影在内的多媒体拓展有成效吗？
饭冢： 以电影和动画为首，包含周边商品、线下活动、实景娱乐等业务在内的全方位拓展真的称得上是多管齐下，我深切感受到《索尼克》这个品牌正在广泛渗透到各种人群当中。我个人的工作内容重心理所当然还是游戏制作，但在精力分配上，参与游戏以外的工作时间的确是变多了。
不过随着近年来 IP 人气持续攀升，在谈联动合作时和其他大厂的沟通也变得更加顺畅，我觉得我们正处于一个极其良好的发展势头当中。
—— 原来如此。顺便问一下，关于海外市场的拓展情况如何？
饭冢： 《索尼克》与其他日本 IP 不同，它从一开始就是一个着眼于全球市场的 IP。在世嘉内部，最早进行本地化和多语言支持的游戏也是《索尼克》，直到今天欧美市场依然是我们绝对的主力。
未来，我们会努力将《索尼克》推广到欧美以外的地区，以日本为中心，涵盖韩国、中国、东南亚等亚洲市场。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/b0e62680356508931da6838da551c641/
—— 也就是一种以海外为起点，然后“反向输入”回来的形式。
饭冢： 没错。最初在 1991 年发售的《刺猬索尼克》就是作为一款拉动 MD（在海外被称为 GENESIS）主机销量的护航大作。
当时开发团队瞄准的就是欧美市场，比如“绿色山丘”这个关卡，便是利用美国加利福尼亚的棕榈树和蓝天等印象制作而成的。
—— 索尼克的性格也非常美式呢。
饭冢： 日本的英雄大多是所谓的“乖宝宝”，但索尼克不是。他是一个比起区分善恶，更倾向于 “只要是自己想做的事，总之先干了再说”的性格。他正是基于这种英雄形象的差异化意识而塑造出的角色。
除了“玩”还要照顾到“看”
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/73ac47c055c2606caca8627dc700c97d/
—— 在各种企划中，加入 ZETA DIVISION 实在让人出乎意料。请问这是怎么促成的？
饭冢： 正如刚才提到的，这是让《索尼克》在日本及亚洲地区普及的举措之一，是世嘉主动提出了“能不能让索尼克和你们一起搞点有趣的企划？”
因为迄今为止常规的宣发手段都不太成功，所以我们正在不断试错，尝试从多个角度让不同圈层的人了解这个 IP。加入 ZETA DIVISION 是这样，与 YouTuber、VTuber 的合作也是出于同样的考量。
(※2026年7月8日宣布加入 ZETA DIVISION。在 9月20日与 k4sen 先生共同登上 TGS 2026 舞台后，宣布退团。)
—— 这类的联动合作，是否也有向游戏玩家之外的“云玩家”进行传播的意图？
饭冢： 是的，我认为很大程度上“根本不知道这游戏”或者“从来没见过这游戏” 是在以日本为首的亚洲地区难以渗透的原因之一。
购买游戏并亲自去游玩的门槛相对较高，但只是看的话就非常简单了。我们认为从游戏实况等其他渠道让大家知晓它的存在，也是一个极佳的入口。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/1f71820a98070567b37f6129351eac42/
—— 在开发游戏时，你们也会刻意注重“观赏性或直播效果”吗？
饭冢： 近年来我们开始越来越注重这一点了。打造“玩起来有趣的游戏”是我们一直以来的追求，但现在我们也会加入一些帅气的过场动画，融入那些让人光看着就觉得 “这游戏看起来很好玩”的要素。
硬件性能的提升固然是一个重要因素，但我们以前在开发时很少去考虑“作为视频或影像是否具有视觉冲击力”这一点。
关于未来的动向
—— 请谈谈《索尼克》系列未来的发展计划，以及接下来准备推出的企划吧。
饭冢： 首先关于《索尼克赛车 交叉世界》，我们已经公布了第 2 赛季会与《哥斯拉》和《新世纪福音战士》联动。接下来会用 1 年的时间持续推出第 2 赛季（共 6 弹）的更新，请大家拭目以待。
—— 《索尼克赛车 交叉世界》每次公布的联动都让人惊掉下巴，请问你们选择联动对象的标准是什么？
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/dabcb5b367d2751470837ac0814ff49c/
饭冢： 我们当然希望各联动作品的粉丝都能来玩我们的游戏，但对于已经购买了游戏的玩家，也希望他们能产生一种“接下来还会出什么呢？”的期待感。
我们不想做那种大家都能猜到的联动，而是希望通过提供意外性和惊喜，让玩家们能持续不断地玩下去，这也是我们决定联动对象的一大标准。毕竟是借用他人的 IP，所以我们始终在努力实现能让双方粉丝都满意的、高质量的联动。
—— 其他游戏还会有什么新动作呢？
饭冢： 《索尼克 Pico Park》也即将在 2026 年 11 月 12 日发售了，敬请期待。
除此之外的情报，目前还没有可以正式公布的内容。但我们团队始终保持着以 1 年后、2 年后为节点进行游戏开发的节奏，请大家满怀期待地等待我们的好消息。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/ce385926a9da8724e5edac3129151bdb/
—— 前几天公布了将在 Netflix 制作新的动画系列，请问这将是一部怎样的作品？
饭冢： 目前除了官方公告上提到的内容外，我们不能透露更多。唯一能说的就是这是一部 “儿童动画”。
本作与之前和 Netflix 合作制作的《索尼克 Prime》以及电影系列的目标受众不同。我们希望打造一部能让小学生和学龄前儿童开心观看的作品。
—— 最后，请对一直期待系列未来发展的粉丝们说点什么吧。
饭冢： 借着 35 周年纪念之际，我要向长久以来支持索尼克的各位致以最诚挚的感谢。未来我们会一直制作《索尼克》的新内容，2027 年第四部电影也将上映。接下来还会不断提供更多能让大家乐在其中的内容，所以今后也请大家继续支持《索尼克》！
原作者：Fami 通编辑部 翻译：奶油吐司车 编辑：熊猫命

items.title: 我将教你爱上隐藏物品游戏
items.summary: Or at least to respect them. I'd settle for that. And if you feel like embarking on a journey of discovery, I

content.v: It's a fact: Hidden object games have a less-than-stellar reputation among the gamer cognoscenti. They're commonly viewed as low effort, vacuous, beneath the notice or caring of real gamers⁠—a sort of proto-slop, in many ways, that predates the rise of AI. They're games your mom plays. Ewwww.

Dramatic exaggeration? Not really. Back in 2016, we published a story entitled " My shameful obsession with hidden object games on Steam ," whose author chose to remain anonymous to avoid the consequences of their humiliating admission—and yeah, maybe that was a bit of dramatic exaggeration. But it vividly illustrates the point that hidden object games are not taken seriously by serious gamers.

I'm here to change that. I'm here to tell you that hidden object games are good , actually, and that it's a valid genre worthy of respect. Because videogames can be anything. Yes, violence tends to be at the core of most mainstream gaming experiences, your Calls of Duty and your Dotas and your Grand Thefts Auto and whatnot. But there's so much more out there. You can drive a bus, manage a cycling team, collect mushrooms on another planet, or play weird card games. So what's the big deal about just sitting back and looking for things?

I was introduced to the hidden object genre in 2009 by Find Your Own Way Home, an 'advergame' for an REO Speedwagon album of the same name. I was shocked to find that it was actually really good—here's an old review , from my pre-PCG days, if you're curious. Sure, it didn't hurt that I was a Speedwagon fan from way back, but it was just fun , too—relaxed and undemanding. Kind of like listening to nostalgic album-oriented rock, but that's a whole different conversation.
The Speedwagon rocks and I am not ashamed to say so!

I've played an awful lot of hidden object games in the years since, and I'm not going to pretend that they're all good. But in that sense, they're no different than any other genre. Which is the point: You may not like them, but it's time to start showing them some proper goddamn respect.

And you might like them! If you've made it this far, then I have to assume you're open to at least the possibility that maybe there might be something here worth giving a chance. And you better believe I can help get you started:
BEHOLD: MY HIDDEN OBJECT GAMES!
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3crzMzyiA9VpHc6ZsD2yne.jpg
FIND MY FROGS

Find My Frogs , and the sequel Find My Frogs: Branches , are probably my favorite hidden object games. They are supremely chill: No timers, no click limits, no penalties or pressure of any kind, and the game world itself is about as sweet and wholesome as you can get. The day/night cycle is a lovely effect, and the ambient audio is surprisingly effective too: Neither has a direct impact on gameplay, but they play a big role in the whole turbo-relaxo vibe. It's basically interactive ASMR—to the extent that if you're into that, there actually is a spot of Find My Frogs ASMR . A demo for Find My Frogs: Branches is also up on Steam, so you can sample with zero risk.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rSVzyCgHh6jjmjomMUWNqj.jpg
I COMMISSIONED SOME BEES

There are actually dozens of games in this series, and not just bees—there are also cats, dogs, ladybugs, frogs, pigeons, mice, unicorns, and more. But they all follow the same basic pattern: Hundreds of tiny animals stashed away in crowded scenes of various styles, waiting to be found. They're a bit more zen than Find My Frogs, because they encourage a state of sort of effortless focus: The world fades, but the bees remain. More for people who really want to find shit rather than just chillax so completely they fall out of their chair, but still very relaxing. You can also give these games a try for the unbeatable price of $0— I Commissioned Some Bees 0 is free.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UCvy5LGib4UtHd6Ro6o2eQ.jpg
SNIPER DAN

This recommendation comes from PC Gamer contributor Rick Lane, who calls its hidden object/FPS mashup "a surprisingly effective symbiotic relationship ." While the title suggests large calibre unpleasantness, Sniper Dan is actually about solving everyday problems for people: Dan uses his rifle to fix taps, clear leaves from parks, open stuck suitcases, or plant flowers. It's definitely more of a puzzle game than most straight-up hidden object games, but it nicely illustrates how far the genre has come over the past 20 years. And, once again, there is a demo.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dBhwwUFoEyTqrnu6w8QVKk.jpg
CAT ME IF YOU CAN

Cat Me If You Can is a fairly conventional hidden object game, but for one major difference: It's fully 3D. This adds a real twist to finding and photographing the game's numerous elusive kitties, because you can't just look at the screen and pick things out—you need to move around the environment and look over, under, and behind things to see what's there. It took me some time to get used to it, and I can see where that added layer of complication might be a little overwhelming for hidden object fans who haven't spent any time in the FPS world. But it's another fun twist on the genre and I like it a lot. And yes, there's a demo.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gj6oWRiD2o98swVPmpiqPe.jpg
MORELS: THE HUNT 2

A bit of a stretch, maybe, because Morels: The Hunt 2 is really more of a walking simulator/exploration adventure than a hidden object game. But at the end of the day, the core mechanic—spot and dig up mushrooms that are damned small and hard to find—is a fit. The game's more expansive 'outdoors' elements, like poison ivy, ticks, bad weather, and animal attacks, might make it a bit much for anyone looking for a more straight-ahead hidden object experience, but it aptly demonstrates the flexibility of the genre. (Also, I like it and this is my list so I can do what I want.) No demo for this one, alas, but it's currently on sale for $5 (75% off) in the Steam Autumn sale.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vPJUZyeXXR3VxwWH8QZLnD.jpg
MYSTERY CASE FILES: THE 13TH SKULL

And here we have the OG experience—the stereotypical hidden object adventure that's the subject of so much dismissive ridicule and contempt from 'real' gamers. But the Mystery Case Files series is well-known to fans of the genre as among the best, and MCF: The 13 th Skull is a standout example: A spooky tale of ghosts, curses, and a disappearance that only you can solve! If you want to sample the 'classic' style that made hidden object games so popular with your mom and her friends, this is a great choice. Again, no demo, but it's also on sale.

Now look, I'm not naive. I don't expect that I've suddenly convinced 30% of PC Gamer's readership to stroke their chins thoughtfully and say, "Hmm, yes, perhaps I have been missing out." (I'd be thrilled to get 3% of you, quite frankly.) But I do think it's long past time that we put the 'shame' of playing them behind us: Like 'em or not, hidden object games are real games, every bit as valid and legit as anything else out there. (And seriously—try one! You might just like it.)
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd-1920-80.jpg

items.title: 《网络奇兵 2 重制版》现已免费在 Epic Games Store 上架
items.summary: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster is currently free to claim on the Epic Games Store until October 8,

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/02/14/ss2-1739543581123.png

PC players can currently pick up System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster for free on the Epic Games Store until October 8, 2026. As with all of Epic's weekly freebies, anything you claim during the window stays in your library permanently. You'll need a free Epic Games account to claim System Shock 2, and the game is played through the Epic Games Launcher.
Nightdive Studios, the team behind a string of well-regarded classic revivals such as those for Quake and Star Wars: Dark Forces, released the 25th Anniversary Remaster in June 2025.
The update keeps the original design but modernises how it looks and plays, including the following changes:

The original System Shock 2 launched back in 1999, developed by Looking Glass Studios and Irrational Games, blending together an FPS shooter with the character building of an RPG. You wake from cryosleep aboard the faster-than-light ship Von Braun in the year 2114 with no memory of who you are, and the ship is overrun by hybrid mutants and hostile robots.

Its influence is hard to overstate. Many of the people behind it went on to make the BioShock games, which are often described as a spiritual successor to System Shock 2, and the game's blend of environmental storytelling and player choice has shaped plenty of what has followed. The original title garnered a 9/10 rating when it received an updated review. Now, this Epic Games Store deal offers a free way to revisit one of the most influential games ever made.

If the remaster whets your appetite, Nightdive also released a full remake of the first System Shock on PC in 2023, rebuilt with new HD visuals, updated controls and a revamped hacking system. It's a handy way to explore the series' roots, though System Shock 2 works perfectly well as a standalone adventure – that's currently $11.99 on Steam with a hefty 70% discount during the Autumn Sale .

Epic is also giving away Buried Stars this week, so it's worth heading to the store for both. It's an anime-style visual novel in which a group of contestants on a TV show must survive a mysterious attack. Like System Shock 2, it's available to claim until 8 October, and you can add both games to your library in a couple of clicks.

items.title: 曝如龙之父工作室实质性倒闭 马东锡版《如龙》取消
items.summary: 据外媒VGC记者Andy Robinson在最新一期播客中透露，由《如龙》系列创作者名越稔洋创立的名越工作室（Nagoshi Studios）已实质“不复…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022237164167.png
据外媒VGC记者Andy Robinson在最新一期播客中透露，由《如龙》系列创作者名越稔洋创立的名越工作室（Nagoshi Studios）已实质“不复存在”，其正在开发的新作《Gang of Dragon》也可能已被取消。尽管官方尚未发布正式公告，但多方迹象表明该项目已陷入绝境。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022237364641.jpg
《Gang of Dragon》于去年TGA颁奖典礼上首次公布，随后由网易负责发行。然而，网易突然撤资，导致名越稔洋不得不为完成游戏寻求约4500万美元的资金。此后，工作室的YouTube频道及游戏首支预告片被从互联网上删除，名越工作室官网也无法访问。在此期间，工作室一直未对外界担忧作出回应。
Andy Robinson在播客中表示：“名越工作室没有官宣，但它已经没了。我听说名越本人最近甚至在其他工作室求职，所以我认为可以说它已经消失了，这非常令人失望。”如果这一说法属实，意味着名越工作室与《Gang of Dragon》均已实质关闭和取消。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022237436648.jpg
名越稔洋是《如龙》系列的缔造者，该系列被许多玩家视为最喜爱的游戏之一。如今以如此悄无声息的方式收场，令人唏嘘。希望名越及其团队中的众多开发者能尽快在其他工作室找到新的机会。截至目前，名越工作室与网易均未就此事作出官方回应。

content.v: 据《纽约时报》报道，在9月25日EA最新体育年货游戏《FC 27》正式发售后，陆续有玩家反馈称，一些女性角色模型在特定过场动画中会出现没有穿着球衣、仅穿黑色内衣的情况。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021148497608.jpg
《纽约时报》就此事联系了EA寻求置评，EA表示，公司“已知悉《FC 27》中存在一个个别问题，该问题可能导致经理的服装在某些比赛过场动画中无法正常显示”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021149002930.jpg
EA在声明中继续说道：“我们已经确定了这一问题的原因，并将在即将推出的游戏更新中解决该问题。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021149078221.jpg
目前尚无迹象表明这一问题究竟是由什么原因导致的，不过EA发言人进一步解释称：“我们游戏中的所有基础角色模型都将默认内衣作为标准技术保险措施。在极少数情况下，如果出现资源加载错误，这项保险措施可以确保角色模型仍然得到适当的遮盖。”

items.title: 《巫师3重制版》遭差评轰炸 3天新增2000多条差评
items.summary: 《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》迅速发酵的差评潮

content.v: 《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》自发售以来表现强劲，不仅刷新了原作在Steam的同时在线人数纪录，还以94分的媒体均分跻身2026年评分最高作品之列。然而，与亮眼数据相伴的是一场迅速发酵的差评潮。
过去三天内，该作在Steam上累计收到超过2000条负面评价，多数直指性能问题与Bug。其中AMD显卡用户受冲击最为严重，Reddit和各大论坛上充斥着画面全黑、草地变黑、树木与建筑消失、NPC眼睛全黑等严重故障的截图。一位玩家在Steam评论中写道：“这是我这辈子最喜欢的游戏，但重制版完全坏掉了。”NVIDIA用户同样报告了性能下滑，只是情况没有AMD用户那么糟糕。

问题根源已经明确。硬件测试机构Hardware Unboxed指出，当前AMD显卡驱动存在缺陷，CDPR甚至不得不向他们提供预发布版驱动才能完成性能测试。ComputerBase的测试进一步确认，RX 9000系列（RDNA 4）用户必须使用尚未正式发布的Adrenalin 26.9.2驱动，当前版本会在RDNA 4硬件上造成严重图形错误。CDPR官方已提醒玩家更新驱动，但推荐的AMD版本“目前尚未推送”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021413421076.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021413433145.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021413441128.png
CDPR表示开发团队正在持续关注驱动问题，并将在AMD新版驱动上线后继续跟进修复。对于已拥有原版的玩家而言，这次免费更新带来的战斗系统重构、技能树重做和画面全面升级，依然值得在问题解决后重新回到猎魔人的世界。

items.title: 索尼改进版 PS5 Slim 的制造成本可能会降低，但购买成本可能会降低
items.summary: It looks like Sony has quietly revised the PS5 console once again, with new internal changes across the (mothe

content.v: It looks like Sony has quietly revised the PS5 console once again, with new internal changes across the (mother)board. It's not clear when these new models came into service, but they seem to have entered circulation around the same time Sony released limited-edition Marvel's Wolverine PS5 consoles.

Spotted by Modyfikator89, longevity and repairability appear to be the key areas that Sony has focused on. The redesigned motherboard offers easier access to the CR2023 battery, the streamlined internal layout makes repairs less risky, and the hardware takes a page from the PS5 Pro playbook with refined liquid-metal containment and revised heatsink materials. In theory, the updated barrier around the processor die should keep the liquid metal better contained over time, ensuring stable thermal transfer performance even under intensive loads.

Sony has also moved to a newer, lower-cost HDMI retimer chip, which likely cuts down bill-of-materials costs and improves display signal stability. Overall, this will likely lower production costs while maintaining higher assembly yields, at a time when sourcing components has become more challenging. Companies routinely make stealth revisions to cut manufacturing costs, but unlike previous console generations that shrank and became cheaper over time, the PS5 has only gotten more expensive since it launched in November 2020.

When it first launched , the entry-level PS5 Digital Edition had an MSRP of $400, but in 2026, you can expect to pay $600 for one. The base model PS5 with a disc drive has increased from $500 to $650, while the PS5 Pro has shot up from $700 to $900. Sony is aiming to make the PS5 a better value proposition as it heads into the lucrative holiday season, after recently launching a new AI-upscaling technology for its base-model PS5s.

Only two of its exclusive games support it currently--Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei--and the technology will be released to more developers soon. By enabling the base PS5 to deliver sharper visuals through Quick Spectral Super Resolution, Sony offers a visual upgrade in select games without having to splash out on the more expensive PS5 Pro.

items.title: 满足了谁的性癖？《脱衣麻将》圣光被做成手机App
items.summary: ILLUMINATION把《超级真实麻将》标志性的“谜之光”遮挡做成手机App，可实时打码，售价100日元。

content.v: ILLUMINATION于2026年10月2日推出了一款名为“合规相机”（コンプラカメラ）的手机应用。它的灵感来自旗下作品《超真实麻雀 Venus Returns》中用来遮挡角色身体的“谜之光”（也就是国内玩家熟悉的“圣光”），如今通过手机摄像头把这套效果搬到了现实里。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021202054993.jpg
应用会借助摄像头自动识别画面中的人物，并在相应位置叠加“谜之光”。光带的粗细可以分四档切换，从最细的“昭和”到最厚的“安心”，正好对应游戏里由薄到浓的遮挡强度；用户还能通过拖动来调整光带的角度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021204473203.png
除了光带，应用也支持像原作那样用麻将牌来遮挡相关部位。官方强调，从人物检测到图像处理、再到拍摄输出，整套流程都在手机本地完成，拍摄的画面不会上传到外部。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021203469723.png
《超真实麻雀 Venus Returns》目前正于Steam秋季促销期间打折。而这款“合规相机”已在iOS与Android双平台上线，定价为100日元（约合人民币4.8元）。

items.title: PS5 Pro官方线下店售价15999！接近原价三倍
items.summary: 近日有玩家发现，北京王府井PlayStation官方线下店内，PS5 Pro的标价达到15999元

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020928003162.png
近日有玩家发现，北京王府井PlayStation官方线下店内，PS5 Pro的标价达到15999元，而该机型国行官方建议零售价仅为6299元，溢价超过一倍。
PS5 Pro国行版本在2026年4月经历了一轮全球调价，从5599元涨至6299元。然而，这一价格在官方渠道几乎无法兑现。自调价以来，索尼官方旗舰店及主流电商平台的PS5 Pro长期处于售罄状态，客服表示“暂无具体到货时间”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020929227695.png
缺货的直接推手是《GTA6》发售前的主机需求激增。数据显示，《GTA6》的大部分预购收入来自PS5平台，PS5 Pro在日本、美国等多地已全面售罄。索尼甚至在日本引入了抽签购买机制，要求申请者过去两年内PS4或PS5游戏时长达到60小时以上。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020929237329.png
官方渠道的缺货直接催生了非官方市场的极端溢价。京东自营专区中，第三方卖家出售的港版PS5 Pro标价一度高达18868元，接近官方定价的三倍。二手市场报价普遍从7500元起步，部分标价突破万元，但成交寥寥。相比之下，王府井官方店15999元的标价虽远高于6299元的建议零售价，但在当前市场环境下并非孤例。

content.v: 前段时间，黑客 Voices38突遭D加密公司Denuvo起诉 ，D加密“破解”团队DenuvOwO 疑似解散 ，就当大家以为D加密破解社区将沉寂一段时间后，一位ID为ARTIFACT的新破解者 横空出世 ，利用Hypervisor技术发布了绕过EA旗下足球新游《FC 27》D加密的破解补丁。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021510217662.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021510249103.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021510245327.jpg
某种程度上，这确实印证了DenuvOwO社区中“按下葫芦浮起瓢”的预言：在解散传闻传开后，有社区成员认为很快便会有新的替代者出现。
当然，Denuvo也并不会就此袖手旁观，毕竟他们已经请求法院允许其向Valve、Reddit和Discord发出传票，以获取可能帮助确认Voices38真实身份的账号信息。而DenuvOwO也似乎是出于担心被起诉而收敛起了锋芒，毕竟比起行事风格更加低调也更加神秘的Voices38，他们确实相当活跃，往往能在游戏发布的第一时间便将其破解。

items.title: B站百大UP翻车？做"原创"游戏被挖抄袭IGN 10分神作

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021114344182.png
靠《植物大战僵尸：杂交版》打出名气的创作者“潜艇伟伟迷”，他的新作《猫猫特工队：代号伍》尚未正式发售，就已经被玩家扒出Demo中存在大量疑似抄袭的内容。

玩家对比后发现，《猫猫特工队：代号伍》的多个关卡在布局思路、障碍安排和通关路线上与IGN 10分《蔚蓝》几乎如出一辙。对比素材显示，两款游戏在特定关卡的跳跃路径、陷阱位置和节奏推进上存在高度重合，并非巧合能够解释。音效方面，有玩家指出Demo中的刀剑音效疑似直接取自《武士零》，这一发现进一步加剧了质疑。

争议爆发后，潜艇伟伟迷2024年的一条旧言论被玩家重新翻了出来。当时他因《植物大战僵尸》改版圈的抄袭事件公开批评另一位UP主，撂下一句：“只有没创意的人才会模仿别人。”如今这句话被拿来与《猫猫特工队：代号伍》的处境做对比。

items.title: 迈阿密热火队将在 11 月对阵密尔沃基雄鹿队的比赛中身着 GTA 6 主题队服
items.summary: The Miami Heat is heading to Vice City for its next NBA match against the Milwaukee Bucks.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/22/gta-6-vice-city-sign-1790108459424.jpg

The Miami Heat is heading to Vice City for its next NBA match against the Milwaukee Bucks. The one-night-only event, hosted live on ESPN, has been dubbed A Night in Vice City , and will see the home team donning an “all-new uniform on a never-before-seen court.”
Presumably, this means the team is sponsored by Take-Two and Rockstar Games for a GTA 6 marketing stunt. As they go, this is one of the cooler ones.

The event will take place at the Kaseya Center at 7pm EST/ 4pm PT on November 18, the day before GTA launches. A bunch of fancy crossover merch has also appeared on the Miami Heat store , celebrating Vice City.

Yesterday, the top of the Kaseya Center , home of The Heat, was lit up to usher in the collaboration between Rockstar and Miami’s home team. This followed a lengthy negotiation with local officials over the extent to which Rockstar could use Miami as a base for creative advertising.
GTA 6 takes place in Leonida, a fictional recreation of Florida housing its jewel, a virtual recreation of Miami called Vice City. In-game, the Kaseya Center is dubbed the Sahara Arena.

Other studios are taking notice of what Rockstar is doing in the lead-up to launch. Earlier, one of the founders of the studio behind Kingdom Come: Deliverance held up GTA 6’s pricing as a potential turning point for the industry and video game prices in general.

Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick previously commented on GTA 6’s price speculation, saying: “Consumers pay for the value that you bring to them, and our job is to charge way way way less of the value delivery.
GTA 6 costs $79.99 for the Standard Edition. The Ultimate Edition, which includes extra in-game content, costs $99.99. GTA 6 releases for PS5 and Xbox Series consoles on November 19.
We've got extensive coverage of GTA 6 across IGN. Check out IGN's interview with Rockstar Games , our GTA 6 preview , and word of the first confirmed GTA 6 voice actor .

content.v: 在今日进行的CFA国际友谊赛重庆站比赛中，中国男足0-5不敌巴勒斯坦，遭遇一场惨败。
本次国际比赛日期间，国足首战3-0击败马尔代夫，随后状态急转直下，先是0-3输给新西兰，今天又以0-5负于巴勒斯坦。
值得一提的是，此役失利也让国足面对巴勒斯坦的长期不败纪录被终结。据报道，中国男足此前对阵巴勒斯坦保持了约60年的不败纪录，此役0-5告负后，国足也首次输给对手。

items.title: Skydance 是华纳兄弟和派拉蒙合并后新命名的母公司，《蝙蝠侠》、《指环王》和《哈利·波特》出现在首部预告片中
items.summary: Once merged, Harry Potter, Lord of the Rings and Game of Thrones company Warner Bros. will exist alongside Par

content.v: 近日，David Ellison通过社交平台发文宣布，派拉蒙与华纳兄弟将合并，新公司命名为 Skydance。他表示，这两家工作室塑造了超过一个世纪的文化，将它们结合在一起并非改写历史，而是为这些标志性工作室配备更强大的引擎。
视频：
Ellison在文中解释了选择“Skydance”这一名称的原因。他表示，在将派拉蒙与华纳兄弟合并时，希望保留两家工作室各自标志性的特质。“它们都拥有独特的身份、非凡的遗产和与几代观众产生共鸣的品牌。我们从未想过让一个新的企业身份去削弱、改变或掩盖其中任何一个。”他说，新名称旨在让合并后的公司拥有自己的身份，同时让派拉蒙、华纳兄弟及旗下所有品牌继续处于聚光灯下。
Ellison还表示，Skydance有着宏大的目标，将以热情、想象力和愿意承担明智风险的态度去追求。“同时，我们将尊重派拉蒙和华纳兄弟的独特之处，给予两家工作室成长的机会，讲述更多精彩故事，并借助Skydance的规模和能力，将这些故事带给全球更广泛的观众。”
他最后写道：“对于我们将共同构建的未来，我感到无比兴奋。”

items.title: PS5全新技术QSSR太强！画质显著提升 性能不变
items.summary: 索尼近日正式为基础版PS5推送了全新的AI升频技术 QSSR

content.v: 索尼近日正式为基础版PS5推送了全新的AI升频技术 QSSR（Quick Spectral Super Resolution），首批适配游戏为《漫威金刚狼》和《羊蹄山之魂》。数毛社技术分析显示，QSSR在画质上显著优于此前PS5普遍使用的AMD FSR 3.1，而性能代价几乎可以忽略不计。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020906111825.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020906133760.png
QSSR本质上是一个性能层级更轻量的PSSR，由索尼与AMD的Project Amethyst合作项目衍生而来，专为基础版PS5的RDNA 2硬件定制。它采用精简的神经网络架构和手工调优的实现，在PS5有限的硬件加速能力内实现了AI升频。
在《漫威金刚狼》中，QSSR能够比传统时间升频保留更多远处建筑的细节；在《羊蹄山之魂》中，原本在FSR 3.1下几乎变成“漂浮绿色线条”的草丛，在QSSR下恢复了实际形状，尽管仍有些许噪点。Digital Foundry的初步测试也给出“excellent”的评价，指出QSSR在图像稳定性上明显优于TAA、虚幻引擎TSR和AMD FSR 3。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020906407412.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020908167025.png
目前，《漫威金刚狼》和《羊蹄山之魂》已通过补丁获得QSSR支持，索尼同时宣布该技术向所有PlayStation开发者开放。

items.title: 《羊蹄山之魂 完整版》外媒满分狂赞:耳目一新的体验!
items.summary: 《羊蹄山之魂 完整版》是《羊蹄山之魂》的全新版本，本作是收录全新剧情DLC弦续关原与全新战斗生存模式——无尽追缉的完整版，游戏…

content.v: 《羊蹄山之魂 完整版》是《羊蹄山之魂》的全新版本，本作是收录全新剧情DLC弦续关原与全新战斗生存模式——无尽追缉的完整版，游戏已于10月1日正式发售。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020924518748.png
今日，游戏的媒体评价已正式解禁，player2给出了10分的满分评价。
评分：10分
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020925148695.png
总评： 去年，我有幸评测了Sucker Punch工作室的最新力作《羊蹄山之魂》。自那之后，主角的冒险故事便在我的脑海中久久挥之不去。虽说遗憾的是我还没回去体验本作的多人模式，但我一直翘首以盼，期待着类似本次《关原残响》这样的 DLC 官宣。
就如同《对马岛之魂》的壹岐岛DLC一般，《弦续关原》是一款剧情向扩展内容，舞台设在虾夷地全新区域关原，故事线直接承接主线核心剧情，围绕主角向羊蹄六杰复仇的主线展开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020925233019.png
伴随《弦续关原》一同推出的还有《羊蹄山之魂：无尽追缉》模式，这是一个带有肉鸽（roguelike）风格的玩法模式，共同补齐了《羊蹄山之魂：完整版》的全部新增内容。在体验完全部新增内容后，我可以笃定地说，这批新内容达到了游戏本体设立的高水准 —— 所以系列粉丝们，欢迎回来继续这场冒险。
虽说《弦续关原》的剧情高度未能企及本体，但依旧是一份相当出色的补充内容；而「头号通缉」模式则为玩家带来了耳目一新的游玩节奏。以上，便是《羊蹄山之魂：完整版》的全部内涵。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610020925347510.png

content.v: 竞速冒险游戏《星球大战：银河赛车手》将于10月6日正式发售，目前游戏媒体评分已经解禁。截至发稿，Metacritic已收录30家媒体评分，全部给出好评，当前平均分为88分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022008048423.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022008057103.jpg
部分媒体评价如下：
VGC：100分
《星球大战：银河赛车手》完美实现了自己的目标。这是一款节奏高速、玩起来乐趣十足的竞速游戏，画面表现也非常出色。即便采用传统单人模式，它依然会是一款优秀的作品，但如今的设计显得更加新颖且吸引人。如果能加入一些经典搞笑角色，再增加一两个星球就更好了。不过，这依然是一款我愿意长期反复游玩的赛车游戏。
IGN德国：100分
在我看来，《星球大战：银河赛车手》已经成为近乎完美的街机竞速体验。游戏的速度感出色，不仅画面惊艳，音效和实际操控同样如此。即使你并不是《星球大战》的忠实粉丝，也值得尝试这款游戏。其新颖的Roguelite玩法以及极具吸引力的战役模式，为科幻竞速类型注入了全新的活力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022008096941.jpg
GameSpot：90分
游戏中的每一刻都充满令人愉悦的高速感，每一个决定都伴随着紧张感。每次挑战都是一次学习、改进、调整和适应的机会，无论最终成功还是失败，都能有所收获。我已经迫不及待想继续游玩，它是我近年来最喜欢的赛车游戏之一。
Push Square：90分
《星球大战：银河赛车手》是一款经过精心设计的优秀作品。出色的操控手感和令人惊艳的画面本身就足以让人推荐这款游戏，而我尤其喜欢其中的配装构筑以及Roguelite战役。游戏拥有令人屏息的速度感，不同星球也会迫使玩家改变驾驶策略，是目前PS5平台较为出色的赛车游戏之一。
GamesRadar+：80分
《星球大战：银河赛车手》将2000年代充满混乱与碰撞的街机竞速体验带入现代，以流畅刺激的高速竞速为核心，并与基于单局流程的玩法以及Roguelike元素进行了融合。

items.title: 韩团性感女星LISA联名PS5手柄开启预购 639港币
items.summary: BLACKPINK成员Lisa联名打造的 DualSense无线控制器开启预购

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021428131896.jpg
PlayStation Asia官方账号今日发布推文，正式宣布与BLACKPINK成员Lisa联名打造的 DualSense无线控制器——Lisa限量版开启预购，推文配文简短而俏皮：“Hello LISA”。

这款手柄此前已于9月21日由PlayStation官方博客首次公开。Lisa本人深度参与了设计过程，将多个具有个人意义的元素融入其中。手柄整体采用 “Chroma Pearl”（幻彩珍珠）配色，这是Lisa本人最喜爱的颜色方案。触控板中央印有她标志性的刘海与双眼轮廓，周围点缀星星图案和加粗的 “LL”字母标识。Lisa在官方声明中表示：“有空放松时我很喜欢玩游戏，所以能和PlayStation一起打造这个系列，真的让我非常兴奋。我希望加入一些粉丝一眼就能认出的细节，同时也打造出忠于我个人风格的设计。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021429345558.png
价格方面，港版建议零售价为639港币，预购已于10月2日在当地时间上午开启，正式发售日为10月30日，以极限量形式通过PlayStation及全球合作零售商发售，售完即止。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021429351623.png
除手柄外，Lisa x PlayStation联名周边系列也将于10月同步推出，涵盖服装、帽子、手提袋、钥匙扣、贴纸以及DualSense手柄收纳包等品类。部分商品于10月2日在PlayStation官网开启预购，10月30日发售；其余商品于10月23日在Lisa官方亚马逊商店及Amazon Music App上线。同日，Lisa的新EP 《Press Play》 也将正式发行。

items.title: 黑神话又双叒叕上央视了！甄子丹解说 献礼国庆
items.summary: 昨晚（10月1日）8点，作为2026国庆特别节目“中国梦·家国情”的一环，武术节目《这就是功夫》引起了不少玩家的注意。

content.v: 昨晚（10月1日）8点，作为2026国庆特别节目“中国梦·家国情”的一环，武术节目《这就是功夫》引起了不少玩家的注意（读者可前往B站或央视频搜索观看）。
该节目由知名武打巨星、《影之刃零》创意监制甄子丹配音解说，杨德战（世界太极拳冠军、全国武术冠军）、曹茂园（第31届世界大学生夏季运动会首金得主）和董崇华（咏春拳非遗传承人）表演，游戏科学提供版权支持。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021446007526.png
节目运用AI技术再现《黑神话：悟空》中的天命人形象，并让其与上述几位武术高手的实拍形象依次过招，呈现拳法以及刀、枪、棍等不同兵器的招式。节目中还穿插了《黑神话：悟空》大雄宝殿的实机画面，以及各地非遗文化匠人的工作镜头。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021446243004.jpg
甄子丹在旁白中解说道：“中国功夫，从来不只是神话里的东方传奇。花果山的月，悬空寺（《黑神话：悟空》取景地之一）的云，西行路的尘。走过千年，都成了我们身边的风景。只会舞刀弄枪，算不得真功夫。功夫，是岁月磨出来的修行，是一招一式李藏着的智慧。”
“你以为功夫只在武场之上，中国人的日子里，处处皆是功夫，不信你看：面案上的快刀功夫、腕子上的流水功夫、刀尖上的准头功夫，连机器人也要秀一把机械功夫。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021447228395.png
“功夫的真谛，其实是时间，没有一招成神的魔法，也没有一日修成的神通，稳扎稳打、千锤百炼，沉下心来才能修炼出真功夫。功夫二字藏在每一份坚守里，这，就是中国功夫。”

items.title: 如果您想知道我们到目前为止对它们的看法，我们已经玩过 8 场大型十月游戏
items.summary: October is here, which means the Fall is in full swing, which means some of the biggest games of the year drop

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/01/pbz-1790892289703.jpg

October is here, which means the Fall is in full swing, which means some of the biggest games of the year drop this month ahead of You Know Who . We've already played some of the biggest ones, so check out our previews of Phantom Blade Zero, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Final Fantasy Resonance, and more below.
Phantom Blade Zero
Release Date : October 29

There are three difficulty options to choose from, but even at the default setting that I played at, Phantom Blade Zero is hard, and I loved that about it. It never felt cheap; it just demanded more from me. In just over an hour of play, I was easily ten times the player I was when I started. It’s a feeling of achievement that is reserved for the very best action games on the planet. If the rest is anything like what I played, I feel like there’s a real chance that Phantom Blade 0 might be one of those games. Read our full Phantom Blade Zero preview .
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
Release Date : October 15

I had an absolute blast with Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse. The art and animation are absolutely gorgeous; combat is fun and dynamic with plenty of room to carve out your own personal playstyle thanks to the variety of weapons, Arcana, and relics; exploration was appropriately rewarding and there were plenty of secrets hidden within the cracked walls of the Parisian streets; and the bosses provided a nice challenge without ever feeling too overwhelming for how early I was in the game. Read our full Castlevania: Belmont's Curse preview .
Final Fantasy Resonance
Release Date : October 22

Resonance has the most impressive use of HD-2D I think I’ve ever seen. It’s absolutely gorgeous, and you can see it from the overworld. It’s the way the clouds pass gently overhead, the way the wind seems to rustle the grass beneath your feet. What’s equally stunning is the way your character’s spite moves through all of this. HD-2D is gorgeous, but it can sometimes look like your character is a little out of place in the world. Not so here. Your character looks distinct, but it always seems like they fit. Read our full Final Fantasy Resonance preview .
Warhammer 40K: Boltgun 2
Release Date : October 14

Warhammer 40K was always such a natural pairing with what has come to be called the "boomer shooter" – these crunchy, nostalgic celebrations of ‘90s mayhem that take notes from the likes of old-school Doom, Quake, and Rise of the Triad. The original Boltgun was one of those team-ups that seems so obvious in retrospect that I was almost mad I didn't think of it myself. With Boltgun 2, the couple of levels I played show a desire to evolve a bit beyond those templates, though. It still has the look and feel of all the blood-drenched classics, while dialing up the scope and expanding the environments and character roster. Read our full Warhammer 40K: Boltgun 2 preview .
Emberville
Release Date : October 27

Between the mastery and class skill trees, loot, and stat points to distribute, Emberville already appeals to my love of ARPGs, while its gathering and crafting systems have the potential to appeal to a whole different crowd too, like my wife, who is a fan of cozier games. That could make Emberville one of those rare games that we can both enjoy together when it releases and serve as an introduction to the genres for both sides. Read our full Emberville preview .
Planet Zoo 2
Release Date : October 13

I didn't even start my Planet Zoo 2 career from the typical top-down strategy game perspective. Rather, I was placed directly into the world at ground height, allowing me to walk around the lush East African Rift Valley in first-person. While some previous Frontier games like Jurassic World Evolution have included this as a feature, making it the first thing you do before placing any buildings or fussing over graphs literally changed my perspective in a positive way. Read our full Planet Zoo 2 preview .
Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
Release Date : October 22

This series has not changed all that much in 20 years. Each sport used either a single Joy-Con or a split pair of them, relying almost entirely on simple motion controls with the occasional button press. I played 100-pin bowling, returning from the original Wii Sports Resort, where a lone red pin denotes the front of an army of pins to knock down. This was a classic back on the Wii, and I’m glad to see it back after it wasn’t included in 2022’s Nintendo Switch Sports. Read our full Nintendo Switch Spors Resort preview .
Stupid Never Dies
Release Date : October 22

While Stupid Never Dies isn’t necessarily a roguelike, it does have some of that DNA in its approach to progression. Each venture into the dungeon has a time limit, and Davy won’t be able to make it all the way to the KOM right away. You keep any loot you collect, but each fresh run resets Davy’s level back down to zero. However, as you progress further you will build an XP multiplier, allowing you to level up faster, and make it deeper on the next attempt. Read our full Stupid Never Dies preview.

items.title: 《皇牌空战8》机型大量借鉴中国歼-20？强到堪称轮椅
items.summary: 《皇牌空战8：希孚之翼》原创强力战机FA-36，因多处细节高度神似中国歼-20战斗机

content.v: 《皇牌空战8：希孚之翼》原创强力战机FA-36，因多处细节高度神似中国歼-20战斗机，在军迷和玩家圈子里引发了热议。
《皇牌空战》品牌总监河野一聪曾表示，FA-36的设计“大量借鉴了美国X-36验证机”。但玩家很快发现，这款架空机型的机身前半部分几乎就是歼-20的翻版。
真正让军迷确信“制作组绝对参考了歼-20”的，是机身上的几处涂装标识。FA-36采用了两侧DSI进气道，进气道内有一条明显的水平带状区域，这是早期型号歼-20进气道的标志性特征。机身上还涂有几条沿轴线对称的浅灰色条——这是歼-20独有的编队飞行对齐标志，用于飞行员目视确认与长机的相对方位，而F-22和F-35都是用编队灯实现同样功能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021615005744.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021615023552.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610021615037386.png
FA-36并非单纯照搬歼-20。它的机身后部两条隆起部位基本与美国YF-23原型机一模一样，尾喷口中间的尾椎则带有苏霍伊系列的典型特征。座舱盖设计融入了F-22的特征，传感器布局则借鉴了F-35的思路。换句话说，这是一款机头“中国味”、机尾“美俄混血”的架空战机。
《皇牌空战》系列历来只为获得外观授权的现实机型建模，中国国产战机至今未在该系列中正式登场。FA-36作为架空型号，恰恰绕开了这一授权限制，得以在细节上大量融入歼-20的设计元素。

In what proved to be a pretty predictable Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, Nintendo announced that a special concert tour would commence in Japan from January 2027. More dates would then follow in North America, Europe, and Australia, inviting fans to celebrating the franchise's most iconic tracks.

The predictability continued, of course, with all concert dates commanding exceptionally high demand. 迈阿密热火队与Rockstar Games达成合作，将在《GTA6》发售前夕举办一场特别活动。北京时间11月18日（《GTA6》发售前一天），迈阿密热火队将在主场卡塞亚中心迎战密尔沃基雄鹿队，届时球队将临时更名为“Vice City”，以霓虹粉色视觉风格亮相。

比赛前后，球迷可期待“特别节目、现场活动、互动环节及其他独特的比赛夜企划”。比赛将于美国东部时间晚上7点开球，并通过ESPN直播。门票已在Ticketmaster开售。

content.v: 10月2日，小红书开放世界冒险岛RED LAND正式开幕，上海杨浦复兴岛再次变身”痛岛”。早上不到10点，船台公园入口处已经排起了长队。这是RED LAND连续第二年落地复兴岛，活动将持续至10月6日。
相较去年，本届RED LAND规模全面升级：场地从8万平方米扩展至15万平方米，超过160个游戏及动漫IP登岛，双双翻倍。据官方介绍，本届五轮售票平均每轮20.6秒全部售罄，这场持续五天的同好狂欢，也成为今年国庆假期最受关注的青年潮流文化活动之一。
https://image.gcores.com/4a4c16ac9959f670816ea0f68e3b2725-1269-951.jpeg
160+个人气IP登岛，打造2.5次元“沉浸式开放世界”
走进复兴岛，巨幅人气角色气模簇拥着机械船台，身着各式cos装扮的玩家与岛民NPC穿梭往来，在这里，青年潮流文化与工业遗存交相辉映。
本届RED LAND阵容不仅集结了160+人气IP，也集齐了多个“首次”。米哈游旗下四款作品首次线下同框，其生活模拟游戏新作《星布谷地》迎来国内首次线下亮相；复联、X战警、神奇四侠与黑豹五座英雄巨像在《复仇者联盟5》展位全球首亮相，迪士尼旗下《疯狂动物城》则第一次把城外海选和后台实景搬到漫展现场。
阵容亮点之外，本届RED LAND延续“开放世界冒险岛”概念，岛上划分翻身时空港、重生试炼场、黄金海岸线三大区域，船台、仓库和集装箱均成为策展的一部分，玩家登岛即可解锁角色身份、在80多个展位里参与沉浸式互动，解锁专属剧情线。
来到翻身时空港，玩家可以去《王者荣耀》的“小王5A级农友度假区”打一场上星小赛，也可以来到如鸢的绣衣楼，在绣球与飞云的主理人游戏区对暗号盖章；可以登上《崩坏：星穹铁道》的银河主题“假日KTV”开唱，也可以拐进迪士尼动物城的展台，沉浸式参与“嚎叫最大声”和“伴舞选拔”的海选。
https://image.gcores.com/9b2a7b2430f98762d053449d231a2f30-1600-1066.jpeg
走进重生试炼场，这里则集结了从3A大作、解谜神作到卡牌竞技等一众游戏展位。解谜神作《锈湖》把 Vanderboom 宅邸整体搬上岛，让玩家第一视角穿行玄关、客厅、地窖逐一解密；拉瑞安的展位里，《神界：原罪2》的阿克斯城广场市集也被搬进现实，玩家逛累了还可以进酒馆桌游区和开发者聊天。
现场还专门设置了“独立游戏大食堂”展区，80多款独立游戏IP悉数亮相。 CD PROJEKT RED、拉瑞安工作室等国际知名厂商的制作人也亲临现场，与玩家面对面交流。

移步黄金海岸线，这里“港口感”十足，集装箱、码头元素与江岸空间，被改造成了滨水的“主题乐园带。暴雪游戏首次聚合魔兽世界、守望先锋、炉石传说三大IP，三座主题岛屿同场，吉安娜主题舞台剧每日开演；《鸣潮》把东方灯会“朝月节”搬到江边，每晚和用户一起点亮电子“孔明灯”。到了下午5点半，全岛还将切换夜场模式，开启夜间专属玩法。《遗忘之海》的7米高“王女”夜航派对、逆水寒连开五夜的“星梦舞会”，无不渲染着夜晚的乐园氛围。
https://image.gcores.com/c35dba234b834be8792454503a5d3451-1600-1067.png
全新亮相的冒险者营地，则以”五天五主题”模式，承接cos、谷子、国风、卡牌等圈层同好线下的交流场。白天，“次元载具试驾会”、“二次元广播体操”等主题团建轮番上演；入夜后，营地切换为月光舞台歌友会，国风、热血竞技、经典共鸣等主题演出依次登场。
正如RED LAND发起人，小红社区市场部负责人白板所说：“我们希望用户走进每一个展位时，感受到的不只是一个展台，而是一个真正可以进入、可以互动的世界。”
首创游戏二次元花车巡游，让同好成为造梦的主角
更重要的是，在RED LAND，游戏二次元爱好者不只是体验者，也是这场线下同好节日的创造者。
本届RED LAND推出全球首个大型游戏二次元花车巡游。每天傍晚，巡游沿”冒险者大道”进行。官方头车领航，蛋仔派对、逆水寒、心动小镇、无畏契约、永劫无间等IP花车随行，沿线设有角色互动和隐藏彩蛋。
https://image.gcores.com/e67cb5a630e6a8206ceef837df0a1096-1600-1200.jpeg
巡游队伍中最具特色的，是首次开放的”主角方阵”——约150位通过社区报名的用户，带着自己手搓的花车和载具加入巡游：有人把平衡车改装成哪吒风火轮，有人蹬三轮，有人则手搓了一架蜘蛛侠主题的机械花车。
“白天，用户在不同IP和区域中探索；傍晚，我们希望用一场巡游，为所有人创造一个共同汇合、共同经历、共同记住的时刻。”白板表示，“在这里，同好不是游客，而是主角。”
https://image.gcores.com/08437aae815d6df97678cfabcd9b31fa-1620-1080.jpeg
这一用户共创的理念贯穿全岛。另一个RED LAND的原创设定岛民NPC，也带有浓重的共创色彩。作为“开放世界冒险岛”的原住民，岛民NPC栖居在岛屿的各个角落，迎接每一位登岛的玩家，和他们聊天、交换无料，甚至倾诉心事，为玩家创造沉浸式的互动体验。
https://image.gcores.com/b5e092f7b3cfba1ae11549ab90ffb537-1620-1079.jpeg
据官方介绍，今年岛民NPC从34位增至54位，所有扮演者也全部来自社区里的爱好者。去年火爆出圈的小菜农裘球，今年自己申请连任，去年散场时与她隔着人群对视落泪的那位用户，她至今记得；同样返场的星星今年来到黄金海岸线当菜农，用户送她的手持小电扇和宝丽来照片，如今还放在她家里。大学老师墨瓜则连夜从江西赶来上海，只为在线下治愈同好们的疲惫。
“RED LAND不是一个完全设定好的漫展，而是一个同好共创的社区线下节日。”白板说，“无论是岛民NPC，还是花车的主角方阵，他们都是社区里的游戏二次元爱好者，在社区里相遇，又因此来到线下，一起创造出了这五天的开放世界。”
线上社区文化，激发线下真实生活
RED LAND的持续升温，依托于社区里游戏二次元人群的快速成长。小红书社区游戏二次元业务负责人萤火透露，过去一年，游戏、二次元相关笔记的发布规模在站内所有兴趣垂类中位列第一和第四；游戏相关月活用户已突破1.2亿，二次元兴趣人群规模达1.37亿，同人、OC、cos团建等原生趋势发布量同比快速增长。
“这一代年轻人的文化，不只在消费中被看见，更在理解与表达中被共同创造。”萤火表示，新一代的游戏二次元爱好者不再满足于消费内容，而是通过cos、同人、OC、角色庆生等方式表达自我，把虚拟的热爱过成真实的生活。这也正是小红书承载的游戏二次元社区文化——即将虚拟文化和真实线下生活相结合的2.5次元生活方式。
如今，小红书正在成为年轻一代2.5次元新文化、新趋势、新人群的生长聚集地，RED LAND正是这种2.5次元生活方式的线下集中呈现。OC创作者津贺林吾专程从美国飞来，带着自制OC“小苹果”的制品与用户无料交换；社区原生创作者超级猫猫兽扮成自己的OC小猫逛展，开起了免费的拍照亭。
官方数据显示，此次参与RED LAND的购票用户，八成来自上海以外的地区。其中最远的IP，来自约19000公里外的阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯。这些同好们，因兴趣在线上社区聚集，也因为社区的链接，而在线下集体奔赴，在真实生活里相遇。
https://image.gcores.com/4ae092639adca2f9d7892ce7143bb404-1079-1619.jpeg
花车巡游的主角方阵中，有00后的工科大学生，通过社区组建了七人的同好团队，一起手搓出这款蜘蛛侠主题花车，有喜欢kigurumi的90后AI博导，不少社区里的同好如今成为他现实生活里的朋友、同事；科技风Coser“杜宾芝麻”，则在小红书上结识了流浪地球的道具师，身穿同好制作的服装在巡游里登场。
作为2.5次元社区一年一度的线下同好节日，RED LAND也是一次线上社区文化激发、引领年轻人线下真实生活的大型实践。白板表示，“做线下源于对真实生活和具体生活持续关注，马路生活节如此，外人节如此，RED LAND也是如此。我们希望年轻人从线上社区，走到线下的真实生活，找到更美好的生活方式。”

items.title: 女死刑犯注射两针没死细节曝光 甚至帮找静脉位置
items.summary: 近日，美国田纳西州女死刑犯 Christa Pike 的死刑执行出现意外。

content.v: 近日，美国田纳西州女死刑犯 Christa Pike 的死刑执行出现意外。
据TMZ报道，当地媒体记者Tori Gessner透露了部分细节，据称执行过程中现场一度关闭帘幕近1小时，其间能够听到Pike持续发出呻吟、呜咽和哭泣声。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022139356562.png
Gessner表示，按照惯例，执行开始后帘幕会暂时关闭，以便工作人员为犯人建立静脉输液通道，通常只需10至15分钟。但这次等待时间明显更长。
现场人员看到Pike躺在担架上，并说出了原本准备好的临终遗言。工作人员随后开始注射药物，她一度进入被媒体描述为“打鼾状态”，帘幕再次关闭。
然而，工作人员随后再次进行药物注射。帘幕后方持续传出类似“打鼾夹杂尖细声音”的动静，持续了将近1小时。Gessner形容整个过程“听起来令人非常难受”。据报道，Pike随后被紧急送往当地医院，其律师表示她目前病情危重，但并未陷入昏迷。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022139291016.png
Pike的律师称她在执行过程中甚至试图帮助工作人员寻找合适的静脉位置。
事件发生后，田纳西州州长Bill Lee宣布，在相关事件接受全面审查期间，暂停该州今年年底前的所有死刑执行。Pike后续的执行日期仍可能由田纳西州最高法院确定，但预计将等待调查结果公布后再作决定。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/02/small_202610022139419468.png
Pike因1995年杀害Colleen Klemmer被判处死刑，此后经过数十年诉讼，最终获安排执行死刑。

items.title: NBA 迈阿密热火队将在发售前一天穿着 GTA 6 球衣并在品牌球场上比赛
items.summary: The NBA's Miami Heat have announced that they will wear GTA 6 -inspired jerseys when they host the Milwaukee B

content.v: The NBA's Miami Heat have announced that they will wear GTA 6 -inspired jerseys when they host the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18, a day before the game releases. Additionally, the game will take place on a "never-before-seen court," and it'll be inspired by GTA 6 and Vice City.
The Heat play at the Kaseya Center in Miami, which was recently adorned with "Vice City" signage, airlifted in by helicopter . The game will air on ESPN on November 18. Tickets are on sale now .
There will also be "special activities" and "unique game night activations" on November 18 that the team will detail later. The new Heat jerseys and court design will also be revealed later.

As for what's available now, the Heat have rolled out a "Vice City Collection" of merch, including a $55 t-shirt that says, "Went to Vice City and all I got was this lousy t-shirt" and a $45 shirt that says, "I love Vice City." You can see the full collection at the Heat's online store .
The November 18 matchup is also notable because Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo is playing against his former team, the Bucks, where he had spent his entire career until this season.
Rockstar is spending big money to advertise GTA 6 in Miami, and some local officials have expressed concerns .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game has reportedly already sold close to 6 million copies, generating more than $570 million in pre-sales.
Also this week, Rockstar revealed that GTA 6 will have more than 170 animal species , including cane toads and monkeys. We also learned that GTA 6 has a new dynamic weather system .

items.title: 《最终幻想 7：启示录》导演谈论其“非常奢侈”的最终萨菲罗斯之战，以及是否有人会再次完成这样的三部曲
items.summary: Naoki Hamaguchi discusses the final chapter of Square Enix's elaborate remake project.

others.title: Signal Veil Is a PS5 Horror Game with a Style Unlike Any Other

content.v: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi must be one of the least guarded interviewees working for a major publisher. Before I speak to him, I find tons of details about the final game in the Remake trilogy spread across a dozen different sources—everything from granular titbits about why Vincent Valentine has a unique skydiving animation to defending the sheer volume of minigames that make the cut. This is someone whose team has built a hell of a lot of game over the past decade, and he clearly enjoys discussing the sweeping vision of it all.

In Revelation, which launches April 8, series villain Sephiroth has summoned the destructive cosmic spell Meteor towards the planet, intending to destroy it. Cloud, Barret, Tifa and company stand in his way—and the planet itself begins fighting back in the form of Weapons, kajiu-sized creatures that emerge from an enormous crater and then unleash mayhem across the land and sea. The events in Revelation cover the last third or so of the original game.

This is the third in a series of remakes that have been defined, in some ways, by their extraordinary production values. I ask Hamaguchi whether he thinks the FF7 Remake trilogy could offer a more sustainable model for building blockbuster games in future.

"So I can't say whether in the future anyone else will decide that they're going to take a famous old game and remake it as a multi-part series, but regardless, I do think that this has left quite a lot of interesting knowledge as a case study," Hamaguchi says via a translator, explaining that his team has now been working together for 10-12 years.

"I think that this project has contributed hugely to Square Enix, not only in terms of the business as a successful game, but also in building this team that I can trust. But whether this becomes a model case or a template is, I think, a bit of a difficult question, because it becomes a question of whether or not other teams can recreate that."
Keeping the same person at the top, too, is vital to how the end product turns out.

"For example, I have been able to stay on for the whole project as the series director because I'm extremely motivated. I've been more than happy to pour all of my energy into this project, but there might be some people out there who are like, 'Well, I've done the first installment in this, and I'm done, I'd like to do something different.' And so if then the top person were to change, that can really change the trajectory of a project, the style of a project, even some of the themes that it's dealing with might be impacted by that."

It's true that the three FF7 Remake games feel like the result of a steady leadership team that knows what it wants to create. Even if someone else could convince a publisher to greenlight three games at once, that consistency is harder to replicate.

"Requiring a stable development environment for 10+ years is incredibly difficult," Hamaguchi says. "I really do mean this: even though I've obviously been in the leadership position, I've had my own skills to lean on and to lead this, it's because the same team has stuck with me that whole time that we've been able to achieve what we have."
Third time's the charm
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ERgGYg3bTwSDX8YHWkJ4H-1920-80.png

It's undeniable that FF7 Revelation achieves the scope it does because it's Square Enix's third go-around: the increased size of the world map with both new and existing locations; the growing roster of characters who each have a rich suite of combat moves; more minigames; the FITS job system which confers additional abilities upon existing characters.

It's gloriously ostentatious as a project—or overstuffed, if you ask the more negative recent reviewers of Rebirth on Steam. I fall somewhere in the middle. I admire how unashamedly massive and generous these games are, even if the flab tested my patience in both Remake and Rebirth.

That may be because they've caught me in my time-starved late 30s. If these games existed at the peak of my Final Fantasy fandom when I was 17, I would've absolutely devoured them. I ask Hamaguchi how he thinks about pacing, and how Rebirth compares to Revelation on that front.

"Obviously, Rebirth has this world map with so much content, so much to explore, but if you just do the story, then what you'll find is that the pacing is extremely similar and the structure is extremely similar to the tight, story-driven experience of Remake," Hamaguchi says. "And we've essentially kept the approach the same for Revelation in terms of pacing."

More of the same, then. One thing that has changed since the events of Rebirth, of course, is that there's a big meteor heading towards the planet—which may change up the urgency of exploring its open world for players.

Hamaguchi and his team, however, have thought ahead of concerned fans on this topic. "So, you've got Meteor up there in the sky, and in the main story, obviously, you're going to have that time pressure, that sense that you really need to be getting on with things because there's this looming, impending threat," he says. "I've seen people concerned that all the side content may detract from that sense of urgency.

"But we have been really careful about how that's approached, and obviously that's something that [Kazuhige] Nojima has really been keeping in mind when writing the scenario. Obviously Cloud and all of the main characters are heading towards this final confrontation and they're very aware of that, but that means that they're also trying to find and discover their own motivations to make sure that they are certain of what [they're] doing, to find a reason to move forward.
"So it's not that you're just rushing into this final battle. They're saying, 'Well, if this is the end, then let's do what we want to do, let's do what feels right for us along the way.'"
So Queen's Blood, dog football and all the other minigames are still on the menu, even when the world seems like it's coming to an end.
Weapons-grade
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FweQgRwXnPpgDv7WoYHzD-1920-80.png
The biggest surprise for me is how much Square Enix has decided to reveal about the game in its marketing campaign, including some things I considered sacred secrets of the original.

I wasn't surprised to see them spoil the playable Highwind airship and how that moves around the open world—that looks rad as shit—but the Weapon bosses were almost playground myths to me while I played the original. I ask if Hamaguchi had any qualms about spoiling them all during Gamescom, including how dauntingly huge they appear in the open world.

"First of all, I am glad to hear that it was a surprise that we would showcase the Weapons," Hamaguchi says, pointing out that the previous two instalments focused their marketing around the characters, and this time they wanted to dial in on gameplay. "I suppose that was what we were going for."
Hamaguchi is determined to match the spectacle of the Weapons in Revelation with players remember them in the original.

"In terms of how strong and how difficult the Weapons are going to be, as with the original, some of the Weapons are going to be part of the main story, and some of them are side content," he says. "And whether they're ones in the main story or side content, they have a lot of unique mechanics and interactive elements; some of them even have minigames in, and are quite strategic in that same way as well.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WtDusyEsKzF49efD4FFKMo-1920-80.png

items.summary: A prominent World of Warcraft: Forever streamer has been banned following comments made on stream encouraging

content.v: A prominent World of Warcraft: Forever streamer has been banned following comments made on stream encouraging his viewers to buy gold on his behalf.

Forever, which is currently in beta ahead of the MMORPG's full launch in November, is currently mired in a gold buying and real-money transaction (RMT) controversy. Players buying gold from third-party websites that use bots to farm the game's primary currency has been a problem for the entirety of WoW's existence and has always been against the game's terms of service. What's changed is that developer Blizzard has made comments that it's looking to more aggressively punish gold buyers in Forever, even going as far to admit its been too "lenient" on the matter in the past.

That more hardline stance against gold buyers was put to the test earlier this week when WoW: Forever streamer Ziqo was seen on stream accepting suspiciously large amounts of gold from strangers in the lead-up to a $100,000 prize pool PvP tournament he and many other streamers will be competing in. Given the huge sums of gold being traded, many believed there was little chance the gold had been acquired naturally through farming and was likely bought by a third party and then given to Ziqo as a gift.

Almost immediately, the Forever community was up in arms demanding Blizzard take action. In a forum post seemingly issued in response to the Ziqo controversy, Blizzard stated that it would increasingly punish not only gold sellers, its standard practice, but also those buying the gold. In addition, accounts accepting large amounts of questionable gold could also be punished by having the illicit gold removed, their account suspended, or even permanently banned. Blizzard encouraged players not to accept "suspicious" transactions to avoid these consequences.

Even if Ziqo wasn't the buyer, according to Blizzard's own words, he could in theory be punished for taking what many viewed to be ill-gained gold. That same gold in question was later removed from Ziqo's account by Blizzard, though the streamer was not banned or suspended, as many players called for.

The same can't be said for another WoW streamer looking to participate in the game's upcoming tournament, Payo. Amidst the Ziqo drama, Payo said on stream he hadn't been shy about the fact he is more than okay with members of his community buying gold on his behalf.
"I never hid the fact I want my chat to use their credit cards to fill my bags," Payo said on stream.

Those comments look to have caught Blizzard's ire, as it was only a few days later that Payo's account had been banned from the game. He has since apologized and said he's never bought gold personally. He said he was "happy" about the ban, because it shows Blizzard is serious about the RMT problem.
Though his main account was banned, Payo was not banned permanently and was allowed to create another account and continue streaming Forever.
"I learned from my mistake, and I will never ever promote gold buying again, that's for sure," Payo said.

In the wake of Payo's ban, Blizzard issued another warning shot of a forum post . Community manager Kaivax in a post on October 1 said Blizzard has continued to take action against botting accounts and those who have bought or "knowingly received illicit gold." In addition, Kaivax announced Blizzard will be adding a warning to Forever that will appear when trading with strangers. The warning that will appear is as follows:
"Be wary of accepting gold from unknown or suspicious sources. If the provider is engaged in Real Money Transactions, you could put your account at risk of closure."
Kaivax concludes by making Blizzard's stance on RMT "crystal clear:"

"Any account belonging to any player that is found to have participated in generating, selling, buying, or receiving illicit gold is subject to the gold being removed, account suspensions, or permanent account closers."

Some players on places like the WoW Classic subreddit are still skeptical. Blizzard has always talked a big game about banning bots, for example, but as any WoW Classic player can tell you, botting is still a major issue. More than a few in the community point to the fact that Payo and Ziqo weren't permanently banned as Blizzard still being too lenient, especially towards streamers. For others, Blizzard going as far as adding an actual in-game warning about the dangerous consequences of engaging with RMT is a major escalation in the war against gold buyers and sellers.
"Players are being given plenty of warning," user Dessiato said in a post discussing Kaivax's forum post. "I look forward to the reckoning."

Whether Blizzard lives up to its word remains to be seen, but there's no doubt the Forever beta is putting WoW in the spotlight in a way that hasn't been seen since the launch of WoW Classic in 2019. Blizzard developers have commented that the Forever beta is breaking records , with the Forever beta population cap needing to be raised multiple times since its launch on September 17. The beta, which requires the purchase of the $60 Skyborne Heroic pack in order to gain access , will run until October 21. WoW: Forever launches in full November 4.

items.title: 迪士尼回应可能收购《堡垒之夜》工作室 Epic Games 的传言
items.summary: One juicy gaming rumor that continues to swirl is that The Walt Disney Company could buy Epic Games and Fortni

content.v: One juicy gaming rumor that continues to swirl is that The Walt Disney Company could buy Epic Games and Fortnite. It remains to be seen if such a deal may materialize, and now a top boss at the House of Mouse has directly responded.

Speaking at Bloomberg's Screentime event this week, Disney executive Dana Walden reminded everyone that Disney already i nvested more than $1.5 billion into Epic for an equity stake . But could talks progress to a full acquisition?
"Those are not the conversations we're having right now," Walden said. "But we have a great partnership."

Disney and Epic are working together to create “transformational” new games . So far, they have showed up in Fortnite in a variety of ways, including the recent integration of Fortnite at Disney's real-world parks .

Walden said people can look forward to even more to come in the next few years. "A number of launches coming up over the next two years ... are going to demonstrate the value of this partnership," she said.

Kevin Mayer–a former Disney and TikTok executive who now runs Candle Media–said Disney's new CEO, Josh D’Amaro, will need to take “bold steps” to help Disney make more money and grow its stock price. One part of this could be buying Epic Games or another game studio , he said.

Technology reporter Alex Heath recently said on Matthew Belloni’s podcast, The Town , that he knows “for a fact” that some senior executives at Disney want to buy Epic Games and are waiting for the right moment. Other executives at Disney believe it would be a bad idea, Heath said.
Epic Games is a founder-controlled company, with CEO Tim Sweeney retaining full voting stock control. He has the ability to make unilateral decisions to control and secure Epic's future.

Epic would not be Disney’s first potential acquisition target. In 2023, it was reported that Disney was interested in pursuing a purchase of Electronic Arts , but nothing ever came of that, and now EA has been sold to Saudi Arabia's PIF.
Beyond Disney's investment in Epic for Fortnite, some of Disney's shows, like The Mandalorian, use Epic’s Unreal Engine to project scenes onto LED screens surrounding the physical set.

D'Amaro is a big believer in video games and has said he wants to do more in gaming going forward . Wall Street is looking for some kind of catalyst for Disney's stock, and many have said further investments into tech and gaming could be a way to help get Disney's stock price out of its 10-year slump. Disney stock exploded during COVID, but is actually lower today than it was a decade ago.
D'Amaro has floated numerous ideas for further Disney integration into Fortnite, including giving players the ability to book Disney cruises or watch a Disney movie on the platform .
Fortnite is a big push from Disney in gaming, but it's just one small piece. Disney today has nine gaming franchises that have individually earned more than $1 billion .

items.title: GTA6开发压力巨大但R星拒绝妥协：一切都要拉满！
items.summary: 《GTA6》开发压力巨大但R星拒绝妥协：一切都要拉满！

content.v: 《GTA6》开发团队近日谈到这款备受期待的新作时透露，来自玩家的巨大期待确实给Rockstar带来了前所未有的压力，但团队并没有因此降低目标，反而选择进一步扩大游戏规模。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609300951258545.jpg
Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Aaron Garbut表示，这次项目承受的压力“非常巨大”，而他们应对的方法就是尽可能做到超出玩家预期。按照过去的开发思路，游戏往往需要在规模、细节和互动性之间进行取舍，但《GTA6》恰恰反其道而行，团队试图同时提升细节、内容广度、游戏规模、互动程度以及世界密度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609300951342061.png
Garbut直言：“我不认为我们以前做过任何接近这种规模的作品。”在他看来，《GTA6》几乎每一个方面都被推向了更高标准，并非单纯扩大地图面积，而是希望让玩家能够在这个世界里体验到更加丰富、细致且密集的内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/09/30/small_202609300951423051.jpg
随着更多开发细节逐渐曝光，《GTA6》的野心也越来越明显。Rockstar此前一直以大规模开放世界和高密度互动著称，而新作似乎正在进一步挑战工作室过去的技术与设计极限。
